issuer_authentication.required_binding: supervisor-signed run/window/actor/tick/nonce request; actor-bound bot.username; short-lived per-run/actor HMAC key delivered only through an inherited descriptor; one-shot nonce, ordered capture_seq, fixed geometry and actual implementation bytes verified before sensor use

trusted_observation_adapter.accepted_native_source: bridge_fast POST /post_k11_visible_block_region_v1 with minecraft-k11-visible-block-snapshot/1; not a LangChain tool or normal guarded action
trusted_observation_adapter.sanitization: validate the entire signed complete untruncated <=65536-byte 75-cell capture before any root/provenance; exact loaded clear-LOS known_air -> false, known_non_air -> true, unknown -> no semantic evidence; actor-private current target_block_present only
trusted_observation_adapter.visibility: actor-private direct current observation; 360-degree conservative geometric LOS; loaded air-like eye and all intermediate voxels; exact loaded target
trusted_observation_adapter.coverage_proof: signed complete fixed 75-cell foot-relative region, consistent registry identities and exact ordered conservative 3D supercover with max 16 touched voxels; unknown never includes hidden target identity
trusted_observation_adapter.supersession_behavior: first known polarity or polarity transition allocates a strictly increasing runtime-local ingest revision and explicitly supersedes the prior same-actor/key sensor root; same-polarity observations including different non-air identity are semantic_noop with no root/provenance/dependency mutation; unknown never expires prior roots
trusted_observation_adapter.capacity_behavior: preflight every planned tick transition against frozen shared root/provenance occupancy before the first mutation; capacity_exhausted commits zero tick cells and censors the run; no TTL, pruning or shared-bound changes
trusted_observation_adapter.failure_behavior: immediate truthful per-cell commit ledger; unexpected insertion/bookkeeping failure inventories actual roots and orphan provenance, stops the run and records sensor_ingest_fatal or partial_commit_fatal; never rollback or disguise partial mutation as rejection
trusted_observation_adapter.authentication: HMAC is supervised source/replay binding only, not Minecraft server/world-truth attestation or protection against a fully hostile same-UID process; no secret values in argv, environment, trace or artifacts
